args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (summary_outlier), 3 runs:
- r05: the centre REGR peak is 52.89 %/h (batch median 0.37). The growth zone is 695 µm (median 42). The largest flank difference is −9.88 %/h (median 0.55).
- r06 and r08: the largest flank difference is at 84 µm (median 316, z −5.05) and has the opposite sign (−0.47 vs 0.55 %/h). The REGR peak is 0.72 %/h, about double the median.
Cleared, 5 runs: r01, r02, r03, r04 and r07. They pass all checks, keep no remedies or roll-backs, and every summary has |z| ≤ 1.42.
What the flagged runs have in common: all three pass rigid invariance, closure and plane sections, and none keeps a remedy or roll-back. The problem shows only in the shape of the strain-rate profile: an unusual growth-zone extent, or a flank difference in an unusual position or of the opposite sign. A faster or slower root would change the peak height, not this shape.
Note: several runs have identical checks and summaries (r01/r03/r07, r02/r04, r06/r08). Check that these are separate roots or time windows and not repeated measurements.
